name: Lily Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Lily Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells organic pigments and pigment intermediates in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers paint, ink, plastic, and pearlescent pigments, as well as fine chemical products. It also provides enterprise management services. The company exports its products to Europe and the United States. The company was formerly known as Lily Group and changed its name to Lily Group Co., Ltd. in 2012. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, the People's Republic of China. Lily Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Lily Holding Co., Ltd.
